items.briefing:
South Australia has launched a Royal Commission into artificial intelligence, signalling growing government scrutiny of AI use and its risks — something training organisations should watch closely as AI policies may soon affect how you handle data and technology. Separately, experts are calling for a ban on smart glasses in Australia due to concerns about covert filming in public and private spaces, which raises real privacy considerations for staff and students on campus.

**Practical tip:** If you see someone wearing smart glasses or unfamiliar recording devices on-site, report it to your manager — it's better to check than to ignore a potential privacy breach.

featured.title: South Australia launches Royal Commission into artificial intelligence
featured.quote: South Australia's Royal Commission on AI signals government-level scrutiny of critical emerging technology risks.
